reviews.review_description: What a shonky team this was...took the money, never connected the inverter to the grid...four years later I find system was never registered to Redback.

Madison, whom I selected from a trio of recommendations from the Solar Choice website, went out of business leaving me stranded as far as after-sales service is concerned. I have contacted LG Chem - the battery is an LGChem RESU10 - and their analysis was that the loss of communication between the battery and the inverter is the reason for the battery tripping. I have been in touch with Redback regularly and they are full of promises but empty on action. I have had to submit a warranty claim but, although they have been in contact with me twice, with different reps each time, I am still awaiting any effective action.
Paid deposit 6 weeks ago.they keep saying they will get back to me with installation date tomorrow. Haven't heard from them  in 2 weeks. Pathetic.

We were given installation date and then were told that the inverters were out of stock so the inverter was installed 2 weeks later. When installation of the inverter was booked I wanted to be present so I could ask any relevant questions etc. I was told the installer would contact me prior to their arrival so I could be home, however I was not contacted so only found out the inverter was installed when I noticed it present on the wall near the electricity meter.It has been a month since the installation and I still have not received any documentation whatsoever and have emailed Madison but have not received a response. They rarely return my emails or voicemails.

The idea was great - install a reputable solar system, so I ordered and paid up front for a 5 kw Fronius with smart meter etc.Installation of panels was mid December 2016.Installation of inverter February 2017.  Madison's installer apparently forgot to send meter information to electricity provider.It is now June 30 2017 and although the inverter is working (cloudy day 3.6 kw on meter) power company informs me as of yesterday that there there has never been any power fed into the grid, despite the installation supposedly being completed.  Cannot contact Madison - message banks full.Is this the normal way Madison Australia does business?  (Please take the "Australia" out of your business name - you are a disgrace to our business community.)Tried calling them on several different numbers all to be met with "This mailbox is full -try again later..."Back in March and April, phone messages left with answering service. Madison employees seem not to exist.I would not advise anyone to do business with this "Madison Australia".I will have a local installer check out the problem, and complete the setup and I will pay the cost myself, of course.Madison Australia will not honour their side of the agreement to provide me with a working PV system.Take the hit and move on. . . we live and learn.My advice - buy solar panels and systems by all means, but avoid Madison Australia.KeithAdded on July 1:Questions about Madison Australia's poor service are all answered in ASIC website.****  Company is in administration. ****My panels installed December 2016, Inverter February 2017.Still no power to the grid s at June 29, 2017 - Fronius system working but no power into the grid.Local electrician to set it right - will cost $400 +Thanks to Madison Australia.Keith

After waiting more than 6 months to have the system installed with minimal effort to followup, I received messages from the CE demanding final payment.Meanwhile - no opportunity to use the solar.  CE offered small discount based - and was hostile and blamed everyone else for the issues experienced.No customer service, delays and lack of response and coordination from Madison, just demands for the balance of payment.I have no idea if it is working properly, and despite requesting the Qantas Frequent Flyer points detailed in the contract - I have had no response and no points added.This is an expensive system, and I read the reviews (all good at the time) - it appears the company has lost its shine!
I would not recommend this company

Madison were great at communicating right up until they got my money, one string on one of my SMA 5000 inverter has not been working for 3 months and Madison said they were organising but will not return my calls. I have been leaving messages for the last 3 weeks with no reply.VERY POOR after sales support.

I'll start with "The electricians who did the job were great", a far as I can tell.  They came in (on time) did the job promptly and left the system installed, but awaiting activation.  This is where my opinion of Madison has gone south.  The electricians advised that someone would be along the next day to activate the system - NO  ONE sighted 2 days later. So I am yet to actually see the system work.  As I write this, the sales person returned my call and advised me that system would not be activated for up to another 10 days.When I first contracted with Madison, I was told installed in March.  Then I was advised that owing to some admin issue, could I wait.  So I did and there were some responses from them, but I had to initiate the exchanges.  Finally I was advised that they were ready to go and the 2 May was scheduled for installation, provided that some meter inspection was done prior and an approval completed with the supplier.  I was also asked to re-send stuff I had forwarded weeks earlier (no problem - stuff happens).  The latest glitch seems to be the approval paperwork is not done.In the days prior to the installation I called Madison several times and was told 'no one is available', but leave contact details.  They don't respond to messages (neither requests left with the receptionist nor emails).  This was now getting frustrating and I had no idea if anything would happen until the electrician texted me the night before advising their arrival for 2 May.   Until the text arrived I was quite concerned - silence is not encouraging.Their sales folks were good at getting back to me, but silence from Madison as installation approached and since.  Oddly the sales person is the only one to get back to me post the installation, after I called her direct.So my assessment is that value for money is poor - every day the system is not generating is power bills I have to pay.Quality is rated poor - It looks good but is not doing anything.Installation - I went with good, which may be unfair to the electricians - The job looks very good, but I have no idea if it works properly.  Eventually I may find out.Customer service - the sales people (both of them) were very good and responsive.  After that I can only rate the experience as awful.The irony is that local installers came door to door to offer systems, which I rejected.  In hindsight - my error of judgement.

TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE AND NO TRANSPARENCY - DO NOT USE MADISON AUSTRALIAI contacted Madison for a quote on a 6kW system in December 2016. I placed the deposit and was then told the panels I had ordered were out of stock and there would be an 8 week wait for the panels to arrive from Germany. 8 weeks later I followed up only to be told the 265w panels I had ordered are no longer supplied and they would be replaced with 300w panels. I was then told I would need less panels to achieve the same output and was given an updated quote which was $100 less than the original quoted price. 2 days before the original install date I had not received any further communication regarding the installation so I again followed up only to be told the inverter I had ordered had not arrived and installation would be delayed another week. When the installation did finally happen, there was little detail provided about having the original electricity meter on the house changed to an import/export meter. I was told by the installers Madison Australia would submit all the necessary paper work. A week later I received an approval letter from SA Power Networks (South Australian Electricity Infrastructure) and in the letter was advised to call SAPN to organise a meter change over. On calling SAPN they advised they had not yet received authority from the Electricity retailer (Energy Australia) and this can sometimes take 5-10 business days. So I waited another 10 business days and then call SAPN for a second time. Still no luck. They said they have still not received the appropriate authority from Energy Australia. I contacted Madison Australia again to ask about the delay and they advised there was a delay in submitting the paper work and this was held up by a week. So I waited another 10 business days and again followed up with SAPN who again advised they had not received their authority. I then rang Energy Australia directly to find out they only received the paper work from Madison Australia 2 days prior to my call (close to a month after the panels were installed). Long story short, I now need to wait another 5-10 days before calling SAPN for the 4th time to organise the meter change over, which due to the backlog of jobs can take another 4 weeks from the date they receive the authority. So I am now close to 5 months on from paying my original deposit and am approximately another month away from having the import/export meter installed and the panels actually generating power!

Once they have your money they do not want to talk. I have waiting weeks for a return call without any luck. I have still not received the safety certificate after 5 weeks and still waiting to be connected to the grid. Do yourself a favour and look for a different installer

Although there were hold-ups due supply Madison Australia kept us informed all the way. Madison's proposed panel layout differed to the other 2 quotes but their system now functioning better than anticipated and reveals the wisdom of their solar solution.

Using a common inverter (Fronius) for all quotes the deciding factor became the quality of the panels. I accept that all the tier 1 panels will do an acceptable job in summer, so the winter performance becomes more important. While we may not get a full reduction of imported electricity in winter, the better result will save more money. This also applies to the shoulder periods of spring and autumn. Therefore, Having the results available from the DKASC site for the Hanwha panels any easy, supported choice.The price was guaranteed. In fact, because we have had roof venting whirly bird installed, the number of panels had to be reduced by 1. So Madison upgraded all the panels to their 275W panels at no extra cost.Madison provided a detailed cost benefit analysis including a graph, for the warranted life of the panels,  that provided for replacing the inverter at the end of its warranty. This is a worst case scenario but does cover that eventuality even though it gives a longer break-even period. It reflects a degree of honesty that is hard to ignore.The system will be installed near the beginning of July so I will be able to report on that later. I have used the recommendation by SolarQuotes as reasonable indication of their installation skill and standards.I have also taken the view that continued existence of the supplier/installer is not critical. All the items being supplied are internationally sourced and recognised, so other organisations should be able to provide support if necessary in the future. Given the rate at which small or fly-by-night companies have departed this sector, taking over support is a common practice.

I am very grateful to Finn Peacock and his team at SolarQuotes.com.au.Everything that I need to know has been answered by your website. And all the information that you have in there finally makes me comfortable in my decision to go solar.All three suppliers you sent me for a quotation are all fantastic, they are real people, they laid all their cards in front of you, you can see and you will know that you are not being ripped off. I actually felt bad I have to choose only one of them in the end but all three are great.In short I finally got the system installed on the 7th of June 2016, five weeks after I made the down payment. The Installation job was very efficient the guys obviously know what they are doing. Independent inspection was carried out just this week. The system is now fully operational and is now able to supply power to the grid.Now what is left is for the supplier ( Madison Australia ) to sort some things out with my electricity provider to take it easy on the bill.All in all I am a happy customer.Thank you SolarQuotes.
Once the system has been installed. I can then give a better idea on how the whole process went.

System only operating for 3 weeks - difficult to judge operation at this stageSmall difficulty with customer service @ Madison with "key" person away. I was not able to confirm installation date and details without several follow up calls
Alinta energy, our retailer are dragging their feet. Happy with our solar system, not so happy with Alinta .

Essential Solar Salesman was owner of business who was very passionate and knowledgable of industry without pushing his own agenda.Best brands at a competitive price plus offered mobile monitoring which others never mentioned.Installer was quick and more than happy to answer further questions on day.
Efficient professional installers

They knew their stuff and provided a degree of confidence others didn't.However, for a premium supplier, they didn't have premium response to messages left or calls made.  I had to chase more than I would have liked.

I found that Madison and one of the other quoting companies offered me much the same product for the same price. Madison seemed more professional. I did not get contacted by the third company. Thanks so much for all your help in cutting through the crap!

We purchased our LG solar panels from Madison Australia who did a thoroughly efficient and professional job with installation. The price was also very reasonable for the high quality of the product. The staff are extremely knowledgeable and always polite and helpful with any enquiry. I recommend them highly to anyone interested in solar panels.I have done thorough research into solar panels and looked at many companies but Madison Australia was the best. Our system is battery ready and we have peace of mind knowing that Madison Australia has the best warranty.
Very good installation and great support particulary from the installation team led by Jessica
Very fast & friendly service from start to finish.Had for 18 months now & working a dream.
Great service from Madison. Only downside is we have one panel with blotches on glass - visible from day 1. Supplier would not authorise Madison to change. Appears to be working ok
Very friendly staff and great to deal with. The CEO answered a call from me and he was great to speak to
Informative salesperson, very helpful and obliging, installers were quick and effecient
Straightforward process.Reliable tradesmen.Neat, professional installation.

Once I was close to making a decision, following exhausting comparo's, the service, communication and credibility of the quality of the proposed system got me across the line. I hesitated due to the headquarters being interstate as I wanted to buy local, however following a review of other customers in SA, I was happy to run with Madison. The arrangements and background admin were all faultless and handled with no fuss and minimal involvement on my part. The installation was completed on time and the team seemed very efficient. Overall, an excellent choice. I have recommended the company to others. ??
I have never experienced this level of service right from customer service right through to the installer, they are absolutely brilliant, a role model to the trade!
In hindsight I should have went for a larger system.

I originally thought that my system would be monitored for performance by the OEM and outages or problems reported to me as they occurred. The Enphase system spends more time offline than online, yet no one at Madison seems concerned. The system seems to work as promised but the support I thought that would come with it (for the additional system cost) is non existent.
The salesperson knew very little, I obtained my best information from my electrican

co. proved itself with this job. I would confidently recommend Maddison and the system to another business operator.
Workmen were very prompt and tidy
When our inverter was not giving daily totals Jessica organised replacement promptly. I was confident that I would get a satisfactory outcome due to Jessica's service oriented approach.
The whole process was very professional from sales to installation

Initial installation which only had one of the two arrays working for six months was very poor.  Since then the system has been above average producing 10+kW hours daily above average monthly prediction provided by Madison eg 23.71 vs 13.58 in June, 58.48 vs 47.4 in April - daily output range -2-73kW hours.

Great system (4.5kW), customer service and installation. My electricity bills are down by at least 75%. The maximum power generation I have experienced is about 35kWh for a day in summer. The installer came from Melbourne (4 hours drive) and installed the system on the same day. There was a 2-3 month wait between installation and connection to the grid, but I think that was mainly Ausnet Services fault.

The day it was installed I was given a quick run down but soon forgot.  After calling your office, I was advised to download the manual - I still find it a little confusing and don't understand the panel.  I would like to know more but would like to speak to someone at the site.  I understand that is probably not possible.The question about manufacture and performance - the system is only 15 months old and there hasn't been any problems to date and I wouldn't expect any so soon either.  The quality of the unit is hard to gauge as I have nothing to compare with.
Our one concern was that the original siting of the panels by the designers was totally wrong for the shade patterns on our roof.

we are waiting until august to have it put in. we already have a 2kw system. they were very very good.very helpful and made sure it would marry up with the first one which was 6 years old. they will work around the panels already there because we had the roof painted and didnt want to move them.nothing was to much trouble.your site was so helpfuli have told others to read it and learn before they buy. the 3 you gave us was very good but we decided that Madison was the one we were happy with.
Installers were messy and left a lot of rubbish after they wer done. Nothing major other than that

Helpful salesperson, kept informed off when the panels were to be installed.  Efficient and tidy install, and quick visit by the electrician to confirm good installation.  Now waiting to see what our power supply company will provide re price back to the grid!
Very impressed  so far and no problems.Actual installation won't happen until our new home isnearly finished.-probably March April 2016
Installation occurred yesterday. Will reserve final assessment until after inspection and reprogramming of meter to enable feed-in measurement complete.

The installation of the  panels was very well handled. The installation of the inverter has been delayed due to me having to replace some asbestos sheeting. The sheeting has been replaced and I'm looking forward to having the inverter installed and the system switched on.

Madison Australia were the only group who came to see us (and our house) in person. The others just gave us quotes over the phone. The salesman was knowledgeable and helpful,[Thanks Firoz] and has remained contactable whenever we had questions about the system.We believe we were sold the best system for our location and requirements with good price tag.Jessica A. -National Installation Manager- was always helpful and fast responding. Installers competent, on time and job well done in under 8 hrs on double story house. Tidy, all rubbish removed.

Good experience overall. Only negative was salesperson not on top of product and its installation. So when installers arrived we had to change roof location configuration from the original provided because it w ouldn't work.
I did receive a quote from Madison through your three quotes system but could not find them in the drop-down box. So thank you for your help. We are very happy with them ad the system.

We know that we didn't choose the absolutely best system but the price difference convinced us to go with the perceived next best. The fact that Solargain didn't come out to quote ruled them out.Thanks for your help.Steve

Madison Australia's service from the beginning till end was fantastic. Once we signed the contract, emails and phone calls were received almost immediately to ensure a smooth and prompt installation process.. During the install, the tradies were very polite and arrived on time as scheduled. They worked hard and left the place clean and spotless! At the end of the process, phone calls were also received to ensure that we were happy with the whole works before payment was taken. In addition, everything was documented on email. It was a clean, clear and transparent process. We would not hesitate to recommend Madison to anyone looking for a solar company.On top of this, we get frequent flyer points!
Very happy with Madison.

We did spend more money than planned but hopefully this will benefit in the long term. Did take a little longer than expected for install but included Christmas period and installers still have to return to install metering.

The staff at Madison were and continue to be fantastic.  From the initial contact of making an appointment, to meeting with the sales rep, and then the ongoing support has been a great experience, as all the staff have been extremely professional and helpful, a real pleasure to deal with.  The electricians who installed the system were also great, efficient, very friendly and cleaned up after themselves.  Couldn't have asked for a better service from Madison and really glad chose them to go with in the end.  They assisted with best system based on their thoughts, which ended up being exactly what i was thinking of installing from my own research, so was really happy they confirmed the right system.  Would definitely recommend Madison Australia to anyone considering installing a solar system.
Have not had system connected yet. Waiting for meter to be changed. Cannot comment meaningfully until system has been in operation for some time.

All three companies you recommended were good - the Mark Group, Madison and Solargain. We went with Madison because we felt they had the best (marginally) quality system at comparable price. I would recommend all three as experienced, direct, and client-friendly.
Good experience in contacting with the sales persons. The system will be installed next year in new house, will comment after installation.
Salesperson was patient, keen to help, find out answers to many questions and followed up after the sale.
The installation and activation process could be improved if the installer, inspector and energy provider worked together to provide an acceptable level of customer service.

The Q cell panels were installed 4 days after signing the contract.  Now is the wait for an inspector and the power company to act.Madison Australia provided information when requested and were very professional in their actions.   They were slightly more expensive than some quotes and did not offer gimmicks such a IPADs or energy efficient lights to win the business.

Madison were very helpful with selecting a system to suit my expectations as it is very confusing with so many solar panels on the market. Prices vary considerably with so many options available. All my questions were answered by the sales team with an honest appraisal of my selection. However the process is taking longer than I expected. (Still waiting to be connected to the grid.) The installation contractor was excellent and completed the job in a professional manner. Overall I would class myself as a happy customer.

I chose Madison based largely on their high quality systems and excellent service which I experienced from first contact. During my initial call, I was provided with far more information and helpful advice than i'd expected. They were super-friendly and and free from any pressure to close the sale.  The installers did a great job on the day and everything went according to plan.

My husband and myself have dealt with Madison Australia since Feb 2014, after we sought a quote from them.  From that moment on they ensured us we made the right decision with our purchase.  Online service was excellent, emails with the latest information on Solar Panels and Inverters, and comparison of packages and size, for me i found this part the best because  our consultant valued our concerns and made sure every question was answered after all this is an investment for our future and I wanted to make sure it was the right one.  Once our house was completed the installation process was done very quickly and effectively, the team were awesome.  All were friendly and no question was a dumb one.  The whole process has been fantastic, we are now waiting on our first bill and we are hoping to see a reduction on our energy bills.

All the companies that provided us with quotes were good and helpful. We found that companies have their product offering and not many companies are prepared to go out of their product offering. Madison Australia's product range was on the expensive side but had really good quality reviews.

I thought I had responded already.    The system is not yet operable as we are still awaiting the meter - promised for next week. Madisons good and have followed up a couple of times. Martina very helpful.
I was very impressed by the ease of the experience and the support from the team. It make buying and fitting solar panels very painless.

Customer service was excellent Installers arrived on time and work was first class.  The service from the Sales Rep was first class, I have already recommended others to your companyAll in all a great experience so unusual these days....Thank you.

We selected Madison from a number of quotes based on both their client relations and the solar technology offered.  All staff offered continuing advice and help throughout the whole process and were genuinely concerned to get the system perfectly set up.
I wanted the confidence in the company that they would around in the long term, should any service be required.

I chose and SMA Inverter and Q cells, installed on a flat roof. The system is performing above expectations.Estimated maximum daily yield was about 12.528 kW/h. Since 1/10/2014  (12 days) I have 11 days at 15+ kW/h. Peak 18.342 kW/h.Had to wait for 3 weeks to get meter changed by SA Power Networks!

System has been in place for just over a year now, and over that time it produced 6,287 kWh of electricity. I am waiting for the next account to do a review of the savings made and thus derive a updated pay-back period.Its not easy getting good information on likely system performances for your location before purchase, so I have no benchmark figure to compare my actuals to, so I don't know if my system is performing well (or better).
Everything was completed when and how it was promised.
Everything was done as explained and when expected.
valuable advisory role in negotiating with retailer and network services

Very happy with my new solar set up. I haven't had an electricity bill since it was installed and I'm making money. The install went smoothly and the installers were lovely. A product well worth the dollars.
It was fine and most informative. Things worked according to plan and Madison's interaction with the local installer worked very well...

Madison Australia were extremely professional during all dealings. Their before and after sales service was very high standard. I did a lot of research and obtained 5 quotes and spoke to many people about their solar experiences, I would say I was well researched before I spoke to the 5 companies. I was amazed at the price variation for each supplier and size of system, also bearing in mind the quality of components used. My quotes varied from $5,500 to over $17,000 for the same size system. Madison were not the cheapest but for best service, value and components used I was very very happy with the result...and no there are no kick backs for this review.
Overall it was quite painless. I thank you for your well organised operation.
Very Happy with the installation and service

I've had a few occasions where the system has shut down for no apparent reason. There is no way of knowing this unless one constantly monitors the system. There should be some form of warning to bring this to the users attention should it happen as this has cost me several weeks of power generation. Other than this, the system is excellent.

Please learn from our frustrating experience with a competing solar provider, who promote themselves heavily, but refused to go ahead with the installation on the day, when the installer noted a minor roof truss modification that had been done 35 years ago. They insisted that we enlist a civil engineer at our cost, to placate their lack of understanding & insecurity. Long story short, I left the modified beams intact, then added extra support that emulated the original truss set up, & did it to a higher standard than the original, but they wouldn't budge on their stance. After many months, & many failed attempts to convince them without success, we agreed to a full refund & parted ways.Not wanting to repeat our mistake, we dug deeper with our research & came across Madison Australia. The difference was night & day, they inspected the roof structure before giving the go ahead, & gave it the green light. The unexpected bonuses were that we got far better system hardware, & amazingly saved $1000 as well.The installation went extraordinarily smoothly & the panels are actually very discreet visually.To say that we are blown away with our experience with Madison Australia, doesn't come close to conveying our gratitude. They turned around what was a very dour period in our lives, into a very rewarding outcome.Thanks to Madison Australia, my pleasurable 30 odd years in ETSA, which was THE essential powergeneration & distribution provider, we can now stick it to the privatisation takeover that we had to have, & was a lie from day 1.It should be very clear, that we have a lot to be thankful for, & Madison Australia is playing a great part in making positive changes.
Installed 21.05.2013 Produced 9500kw in 12 months!
I was very happy with the system I purchased from Madison Australia.  I feel i made the right choice, and will recommend them in the future.

The friendly,  helpful and polite, not pushy staff were fantastic and no question was too hard to answer.I felt at ease at all times and this was the smoothest installation of a product I have ever experienced.I have no hesitation in HIGHLY RECOMMENDING Madison Australia to friends,  family and the public.From my first visit to the installers to the solar system to the follow up phone calls I will definitely use Madison Australia again.

Our Consultant (Martina) was very professional and friendly and explained all aspects of the system very well. Installation was very quick after accepting the quote and the contractors were very efficient. We were kept in the loop at all times and have had follow up phone calls to check that everything was ok and we were happy with the system. We would definately recommend Madison Solar if you are contemplating solar.

Hi FinnThank You for your service and all your helpful informationI can't tell much yet, I signed the contract 7  weeks ago, the Q cells Panels were installed 2 weeks ago. Still waiting for the inspection.Service is a bit slow compered to Madison's advertising of 6 to 7 weeks completion.
It was quick , all finished in one morning,  the new meter installed in the afternoon , I have the solar power at 3PM.

Madison Australia contacted us immediately and were very prompt in coming to see us, within 24 hours. The sales rep was very helpful and not at all pushy allowing us time to consider all aspects. The installation occurred promptly and on time. The company followed up on the same day to check we were happy and all had gone well. I cannot find fault in any way with Madison Australia and would recommend them to anyone considering Solar. Thank you Solar Quotes for passing on our details, your recommendations and unbiased/uneditted reviews made the process painless and gave me confidence.

Johanthan was very informative about the product, not pushy for a sale and was able to send through a vast amount of reading material and understood what we wanted to achieve in price and product for our elderly father. Still not installed so cannot comment on this or yet the savings if they match what they have stated.Gryphon Solar was to pushy for a sale not prepared with reading material and wanted us to sign on the spot very poor.
Friendly salesperson who knew her product. professional installation on schedule and no mess left behind.  follow-up call to make sure I was happy with my solar system.

Excellent advice on how to decide on size of system needed. Knowledgeable about types of panel and invertors etc. Excellent step-by-step explanation of the installation process. Installation was very professional and installer very helpful in explaining how to switch the system on after the meter was changed. There was good after installation service with a follow up phone call.  We installed a 5 kW system which at times generates over 6 kW and we have had not problems whatsoever. Very impressed.
From initial consultation to installation, we were treated as though we mattered and were kept in the loop. Fully satisfied at this point but early days yet.
Other companies slow to respond with quote.

Madison was the only one to make a personal visit to fully explain the systems and suggested which system would suit us best. They were not pushy and also provided other websites for us to explore and to allow us to make the decision in our own time.One other supplier contacted us by phone and was very pushy and put time constraints on our decision to go with them.The other supplier only sent an email...

Thank you to the local SA services of Madison Australia.I believe you provided the best system I could purchase for the price.Your service was very efficient from sales to installation.I highly recommend your services.

The quoting service we received via the Solar Quotes referrals was handled highly professionally and most helpfully by the companies that we consulted. Sales staff were top notch in both cases and the final decision came back to one of price. Even then there wasn't much between them. Madison completed installation today without any fuss or difficulties and the system is working, subject to meter updating by SA Power Networks. We've been very impressed from start to finish and wouldn't hesitate to recommend both the process and the companies involved.

From the initial consultation Madison have been a pleasure to deal with.  The sales person was passionate about the company and the product.  They took the time to listen to us, share their knowledge and answer our questions (unlike some of the other providers we contacted that were trying to rush us, and would talk over the top of us).The installation took around 2 hours.  The team knew what they were doing and just got on with it.The salesperson came back after the system was connected to make sure that we were happy with the product and we are. Extremely Happy!The main reason we went with Madison was because of the QCells panels that they offer.  The really are a premium panel.  My install is western facing, and on a brigh sunny December day (2013), I am generating around 28kwh for the day.

Madison experience was excellent from sales to installation any question you would answer their would help you out and explain every thing about solar systems and the inverter, their return back in 12 months follow up. Excellent job.

BEFORE THE SYSTEM WAS INSTALLED , WE DISCUSSED WHICH OPTIONS WERE THE BEST FOR THE PANEL ARRANGEMENT AND THE INVERTER POSITION.THE INSTALLERS WERE VERY GOOD THE JOB WENT VERY SMOOTHLY. I PICKED THE Q CELLS Q.PRO G3 PANEL AND SMA SB 5000TL-21 Inverter

Madison Australia were easy to deal with. I explained what I needed and they knew the answers to all my concerns. There was no sales pitch and no salesman on the doorstep.
